description: Express.js web application called "GetTheFirst" - A user registration and login system running on localhost:3000. The application tracks user registration order (user numbering) and appears to have a challenge element with distance/hint information provided during registration.
notes: Application is accessible via HTTP on port 3000 (localhost). Main endpoints discovered: /, /register, /login, /profile/{userId}, /info, /starttime. The registration endpoint returns JSON with userId, userNumber, message, maybehint, and distance fields. Login redirects to POST /profile/{userId}. The application tracks first user registration timestamp (2025-12-01T16:04:08.000Z).
